dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon seems to have been pretty busy lately. The Masters of the Night-Wind haven't made any big announcements, have they?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: No news on my end. How about you?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: Uh... If I knew what was going on, why would I be asking you?

dialogues.speaker: Coyopa
dialogues.text: ...Well, either way, nothing much we can do about it, and there's no point in just standing here. Why don't we go grab a drink instead?

dialogues.speaker: Coa
dialogues.text: You're not trying to trick me into going to Xocolatl Beverages again, are you? How about... No.
